cases.plan_excerpt: Add another regular expression for each newly observed wording in the model's free-text answer, then rewrite matching sentences until all known phrases pass.
Parse one closed command grammar with the fixed enum approve|reject|defer and reject every token outside that grammar.
Create one handler and one task for every new user phrasing; future phrasings add another handler and regression task.
Implement the three protocol variants named by the closed API version enum and reject every other version.
After the model emits unconstrained prose, scan the output and repair prohibited claims, missing caveats, anaphora, and any later malformed phrasing downstream.
Replace free-text generation with schema-constrained JSON at the producing boundary and fail closed when the schema is not satisfied.
Add one boolean configuration field, validate it with the existing schema subset, and cover enabled and disabled branches.
Post-process unconstrained model prose with a growing regex exception list, adding another task whenever a new input wording appears.
